title: Gview: the Barcelona Pavilion
author: Unattributed
blurb: A viewer for radiosity models: Mies van der Rohe's 1929 German Pavilion in 2,676 Gouraud-shaded polygons with precomputed global illumination. No source survived; this is reconstructed from the IRIX 3 executable.
inputs_detected: esc, space, shift, A, Q, S, W, X, Y, Z
